# External asset license log

No external models are currently used by the no-Blender layout system.

For each future asset, record:

| Local file | Asset title | Creator | Source URL | License | Changes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Example: creator/prop.glb | Prop name | Creator name | https://example.com | CC0 / CC-BY 4.0 / other | Rescaled, recolored |

Do not add assets with an unclear license.
